display_information.name: Upwork Pipeline
display_information.description: Posts qualified Upwork jobs for approval and returns Claude-drafted proposals.
display_information.long_description: Part of the upwork-job-pipeline project. Upwork job postings are scored by Claude against a written rubric and posted here as a card. React with a white_check_mark to have a proposal drafted for you in a thread; react with an x to skip. Nothing is ever submitted to Upwork automatically - every submission is a manual human action.
